title: John Turturro Honored at Marrakech Film Festival
excerpt:
The festival celebrates the actor's career and screens his latest film.
An interview also addresses his work with Robert De Niro and modern filmmaking.
body_md:
The 23rd Marrakech International Film Festival honored John Turturro's career, which includes performances in Do the Right Thing, Barton Fink, The Big Lebowski and Quiz Show.

His presence also extends to the festival's film program. The Only Living Pickpocket in New York marks Noah Segan's feature directorial debut and is produced by Rian Johnson.

The headline of an accompanying interview refers to disagreements with Robert De Niro over the number of takes and Turturro's views on changes in modern filmmaking. The available excerpt does not contain his full answers, so the precise circumstances and quotations cannot be established from it.
